item.title: ‘All I want to do is cry’: trauma of 7 October survivors three years after the attacks
item.description: Israeli communities shattered by Hamas massacres are torn between rebuilding their lives and remembering lost friends and relatives Keith Siegel spent many of his long hours in Hamas captivity in Gaza etching everything that happened after 7 October 2023 into his memory. For 484 days, he recited to himself every place he was held, the dates he was moved and every attack or humiliation he endured or witnessed. He aimed to store intelligence that could help Israeli forces free other hostages if he was released, to keep track of time as the days slid by and be able to tell his family what… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: Hace ya siete meses que Irán decidió cerrar el estrecho de Ormuz, en respuesta a la ofensiva estadounidense e israelí del 28 de febrero. Las consecuencias se han dejado notar en el transporte marítimo, el suministro de crudo y el notorio aumento del precio de los combustibles a nivel global. Aunque no sabemos cuánto más se prolongará este pulso entre Washington y Teherán ni cómo evolucionará un conflicto que, a día de hoy, sigue en punto muerto, sí tenemos ya una estimación de cuánto podría tardar el mercado en recuperar la normalidad una vez el estrecho vuelva a funcionar a total capacidad… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: Catalan separatist Puigdemont to return to Spain after warrant lifted
item.description: A Spanish judge on Tuesday lifted an arrest warrant for exiled former Catalan separatist leader Carles Puigdemont, paving the way for his return to Spain ahead of a general election in November. Supreme Court judge Pablo Llarena made the move after Spain’s Constitutional Court backed extending a 2024 amnesty law to include the crime of embezzlement. The law was aimed at easing tensions in the wealthy northeastern region following its failed 2017 independence bid, Spain’s worst political crisis... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post.
